MomDom.
noun /mämˈdäm/

The mental load of motherhood — and a place to put it so you don’t carry it alone.

Moms carry an invisible database of family life.

teacher names doctor information clothing sizes food preferences medicine timing gift ideas gift hiding spots packing lists school login info favorite snacks forms to return places the family wants to try
And even with every planner, calendar, app, notebook, list, and screenshot… the information is still scattered.
planner
calendar
notes
apps
lists
screenshots
Mom is still the place where it all connects.
MomDom is being built to help support that. By giving family knowledge a trusted place to live, Mom doesn’t have to be the only place holding all of it together.

Real moms. Real life.

What would you set down?

These are the kinds of little details moms told us they keep track of all over the place.

Kids’ sizes + gear LynnAnn: softball bat 29″ / 19 oz · Carly: size 5T, shoe size 12.
Gifts Gift ideas, holiday shopping lists, and what you’ve already bought.
Places + things to try Restaurants to try, movies to watch, places you loved, and ideas for where to go next.
Health details A symptom, medicine timing, or something to remember for the next doctor’s appointment.
Food + favorites Favorite snacks, go-to restaurant orders, food preferences, or the meal everyone actually liked.
Packing + plans Your yearly family-trip packing list, travel plans, or the lists you know you’ll need again.
This is the beginning

MomDom is being built to connect more of family life over time.

The pilot starts with capture and context. The bigger vision is a calmer home for the information, plans, people, routines, and details that keep a family moving.

We’re starting small on purpose.Real moms are using the pilot in everyday life, and what they need from it will help shape what MomDom builds next.
